method: Manual visual comparison of all four generated views against real photos and cat.png; not camera calibration, not a numerical similarity score

checks.frontal_asymmetric_cheeks: Right orange, left predominantly black retained
checks.left_side: Black cheek under warm brow and broad black shoulder retained; no mirrored orange cheek
checks.right_side: Orange cheek, black shoulder, orange/black flank and right leg markings retained
checks.back: Head faces forward, black/orange nape and dark-tipped raised tail; no broad white dorsal collar
checks.pose: Full body in each view; front corrected to centered head/body, side profiles approximately align head with spine; no obvious added limbs
checks.cross_view: Major body proportions and raised curled tail visually compatible; no calibrated proof
checks.style: Matte faceted natural feline appearance is adequate for this reconstruction test, with locally fine facets still present

limitations: Exact coat boundaries and standing proportions inferred
Rear/underside coat not fully observed in photos
Side cameras still have mild obliqueness; not exact orthographic matrices
Potential subtler view inconsistency must be checked on actual 3D
Final cat.png appearance, UV, eye geometry/material and animation not accepted by this reference review
manual_inputs: Existing per-cat photo roles and identity descriptions
Human visual QA of reference set
